removed_paragraphs.en: This operation count assumes constant-time list indexing and bounded-integer arithmetic. List growth needs a qualification. In [CPython v3.14.0's list implementation](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.14.0/Objects/listobject.c), a list stores references in an indexed array and reserves spare capacity when growing. An append can occasionally copy many references, but a long run of appends has linear total resizing work. End pops avoid shifting the remaining entries; occasional shrinking also costs work. Shrinking waits until length falls below half the allocated capacity, leaving a gap before another comparable resize. These implementation facts support amortized constant time per end operation, meaning constant cost averaged across a sequence of operations, rather than a promise that each individual call takes equal time. Geometric growth or shrink sizes make the copied capacities sum to a constant multiple of the largest reached size; interleaved growth and shrink must cross those capacity gaps again, so their work can be charged to the intervening updates.
removed_paragraphs.zh-TW: 這個操作次數計算假設 list indexing 與有界整數算術需要固定時間。list 成長還需要一項限定。[CPython v3.14.0 的 list 實作](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.14.0/Objects/listobject.c) 將參照存放在可按 index 存取的 array，成長時會預留額外 capacity。單次 append 偶爾可能複製許多參照，但一長串 append 的總 resizing 工作量是線性的。從尾端 pop 不必搬移其餘項目；偶爾縮小容量也要花費工作。縮容會等到長度低於已配置容量的一半才發生，因此距離下一次同等規模的 resize，仍隔著一段容量差。這些實作事實支持每次尾端操作的 amortized constant time，也就是把成本攤在一串操作上，平均每次為固定成本，而非承諾每次呼叫都花一樣的時間。成長或縮小時的容量呈幾何級數，讓被複製的各次容量總和不超過最大容量的固定倍數；成長、縮小交錯時，必須重新跨過那些容量差，才能再次 resize，因此可以把相關工作攤給中間的更新。
